question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Perjury
solution: The correct answer is **"Falsehood"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's see the meanings of the given words- • **Perjury- **the offense of willfully telling an untruth or making a misrepresentation under oath (न्‍यायालय में असत्‍य कथन, झूठी गवाही, शपथ-भंग). • **Melancholy- **a feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause (चिरकाल तक रहने वाली विषाद-भावना या उदासी). • **Frankness- **the quality of being open, honest, and direct in speech or writing (स्‍पष्‍टता). • **Penury- **the state of being very poor; extreme poverty (अत्यधिक ग़रीबी, दरिद्रता; अति अभाव की स्थिति). • **Falsehood- **the state of being untrue (झूठ) • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is** "Falsehood" i.e. Option 4.** 3e:T575, The erroneous part is** "they were governed"**
